scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, vLLM online quantization discovery screens
baseline: adjacent BF16 vLLM: 355.521 ms E2E, 9.997 ms TPOT

screens.mode: fp8 per-tensor plus vLLM norm/activation quantization fusions

screens.result: vLLM reported zero quantized layers because this shorthand targets MoE weights and the active text model is dense

conclusion: Quantization is not a standalone advantage over vLLM because vLLM already supplies the baseline implementations. The useful agent action is to select the best supported quantized path for the frozen hardware/workload/quality target, identify layers it leaves expensive, and optimize those residual bottlenecks.
